name: facebakery_rotate
describe: FaceBakery vertex rotation. rotatePart() rotates a model vertex about an axis through an origin using an LWJGL Matrix4f.rotate matrix, with the 22.5/general rescale branches; rotateVertex()'s geometric part is ForgeHooksClient.transform (javax.vecmath row-major 4x4, fed as input). PURE: BlockPartRotation -> axis/angle/origin/rescale params; the ITransformation matrix is an input (its ModelRotation/TRSR construction is upstream/out of scope).
